prompts.A:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, brand-new mobile APP SCREEN bitmap, not a poster, not a web page, not a diagram. This is a new alternative design for Hangul Sori, a Korean-learning app. Straight-on flat screen filling the entire image, portrait aspect ratio exactly 402:874, ideally 1206x2622 pixels. NO device frame, no hands, no angled phone, no surrounding desktop, no comparison panels, no labels A/B/C outside the app.
QUALITY: premium Korean C-design craft matching rich jade lacquer, warm textured hanji paper, restrained brass edges and realistic subtle contact shadows. Professional contemporary mobile hierarchy; original physical material surfaces, crisp live-looking sans-serif typography, clean alignment. ONE upper-left light source, visible shallow card thickness, buttons with a small side surface and pressable depth. No excessive ornament, no garish game chrome, no wide gold frames, no glassmorphism.
CHARACTER: a cheerful youthful Korean Dokkaebi boy, the original app character in a miniature handcrafted 3D/clay-like render: tousled black hair, cream patterned headband, dark expressive eyes, friendly smile, white shirt, red and teal traditional patterned sleeveless wrap vest, dark blue sash and tassels, muted teal-green baggy trousers, woven straw sandals. Entire body visible. His right arm raises a carved wooden magic club with a teal cloud motif above his head; his other arm reaches outward. The whole club, hand, hair, both feet, and shower of gold square-holed Korean yeopjeon coins must remain visible. Preserve saturated original clothing colors; never grayscale. The coin shower represents a still from the user's full transparent-background video. The subject is composited naturally onto the designed material backdrop: NO white rectangular video background, no visible video frame or playback controls. The FULL square video frame has its own reserved area, not a circular clipping mask. A restrained few cyan magic fragments and gold coins support the actor, without covering text.
COPY: all readable app UI strictly in German and exact text; no Korean labels, no lorem ipsum, no invented extra actions or claims. Title "Lektion geschafft"; short reason "Für deine erste Lektion heute"; reward "+20" with currency "Yeopjeon"; wallet "90"; construction title "Dein Ildu-Haus", short status "Nächster Bauschritt bereit", cost "Baukosten: 40". Main gold tactile button "Zum Ildu-Haus" and secondary deep-jade tactile button "Weiterlernen". Small brand "HANGUL SORI". Show each relevant label only once. Tiny iOS status bar9:41, dynamic island, and bottom home indicator are allowed.
HEIGHT & SAFETY: layout coordinates refer to402x874logical pixels. Top system safe region0–62, bottom840–874. Two FULL-WIDTH bottom CTA buttons x24,width354: gold y716,height56 and jade y780,height48, 8px between. Thus buttons finish close to the bottom, NOT halfway down the screen. At 100% font the entire screen fits with NO scrolling, all labels readable, CTA copy approx16px logical, small supporting copy14px logical. Text-image gaps4–8; groups12–16; no large blank lower area. Use the content and hero scene to occupy full available height, not random padding.
BUILD MYSTERY: only words and a small tasteful brass lock for the NEXT Ildu construction action. No actual hanok, roofs, silhouettes, architectural blueprints, construction stages, stage counts, cloth cover, treasure chest, bags, mysterious fabric or building preview. Do not show future approved house art. No replay, motion-off, sound, review controls or tab bar inside the screen.
Create an entirely NEW composition. Do NOT reproduce the previous short compact cream card, small left video with right20, and huge empty jade bottom. It must look shippable and confident rather than like a stock card stack.
CONCEPT A — JADE STAGE / REWARD LEDGER. Background is a richly grained deep jade lacquer field with barely visible Korean cloud engraving. Header x24,y76–132: small cream HANGUL SORI and bold26px cream title. Full square transparent-video stage x25,y144,352x352, character centered and very large, gold coins spread naturally on an invisible plane with a soft contact shadow. No surrounding card around the video. Below it, a wide warm hanji ledger x24,y508,width354,height104 has a beautiful shallow paper edge. Ledger is TWO CLEAR COLUMNS: left "Belohnung", huge46px "+20", small "Yeopjeon"; right "Guthaben",32px "90" beside a small embossed yeopjeon icon. Do not put another wallet in the header. Reason text is a short line carefully integrated at the ledger top or below the header, without crossing the square video region. Next-action block x24,y624,width354,height80 is a low jade/brass plinth with small brass lock on the left and the exact house/title/status/cost copy, organized into two readable rows. Buttons occupy the fixed lower positions. Scene flows down into ledger then next-step then CTA. Restrained brass rim, matte paper, rich dimensional character. No outer enclosing paper card. Layout fills top to bottom through352px video and material hierarchy.
